# dsh-browser-playwright-codex
[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-browser-playwright-codex) [](LICENSE) [](package.json) [](https
://github.com/miqian-nomad/dsh-browser-playwright-codex/releases)
> [](https://www.dsh.so/zh/artifact/dsh-browser-playwright-codex/) [](https://www.dsh.so/zh/artifact
/dsh-browser-playwright-codex/)
**一句话**：让 AI 用你**已经登录的账号**在真实网页上干活 —— 填表、抓取列表、多标签查后台；浏览器窗口就在你桌面上、你随时看得见。原生弹框会被挂起、**绝不替你点「确定」**（机制级）；
验证码/挑战页会被识别出来，并以提示要求模型停下交给你（**提示不是阻断**）。登录/二次验证**没有探测器**，靠模型从快照看出来并停下；密码、一次性验证码、卡号字段 `browser_fill`
**直接拒绝**——这类字由你本人在窗口里输。

**In one line**: the agent drives a **visible, profile-backed browser window** with the logins you
a

lready have — filling in forms, scraping lists and working across tabs in real pages — through
acces

sibility snapshots with stable element refs. Native dialogs are parked and reported instead of
auto-
accepted. Challenge pages are detected and reported as a note that tells the agent to stop and hand

the page back — a note, not a block. There is **no sign-in detector**, and `browser_fill` refuses
pa

ssword / one-time-code / card fields outright — you type those in the visible window. No
CSS-selecto
r guessing, no full-DOM dumps.

**Compatibility.** Built and tested against DSH `0.2.0-rc.1`. The dependency ranges are **floors, no

t
wildcards**: peers `@deepseek-ai/cordis` `>=4.0.4`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` `>=0.2.0-rc.1`,
`@deeps
eek-ai/dsh-tools` `>=0.2.0-rc.1`, and the direct dependency `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` `^3.18.4`. Th

e
floors exist so an empty project cannot resolve a very old `0.0.1-rc.*` build, while a newer harne

ss still
installs. One cost of npm's prerelease rules: a prerelease whose `[major, minor, patch]` tu

ple differs from
`0.2.0` (for example `0.2.1-rc.*`) is outside a `>=0.2.0-rc.1` range, so you may se

e a **peer warning** — a
warning, not an install failure (pnpm does not enforce peer ranges strictly

by default). After a harness
upgrade, `npm run doctor` re-checks that every named export this plugi

n imports still exists — that is the
fast way to tell "the harness moved" from "the plugin broke".
`lib/` ships in the repository (and there is deliberately no `prepare` hook), so a fresh clone loads
without a build step — `npm run build` is only needed after editing `src/`.
The bundle mounts three rows: the `ctx.browser` seam (`service`), the Playwright provider (`playwrig
ht`), and the model-facing tool family (`tool`).

Install it and ask for something that leaves a visible result — there is nothing else to configure:

Two habits worth having on day one:
- **Let it look before it clicks.** Start from `browser_snapshot`; a `ref` is only valid in the resu

lt that
produced it (a stale one fails fast instead of clicking something else).
- **Say "stop" for

the irreversible step.** Submitting, paying, deleting and sending are the points where

### Browser binary
The provider probes `chromium` → `chrome` → `msedge` → `edge` channels automatically; any installed
Chromium-family browser works with **zero download**. To use Playwright-managed Chromium instead:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or pin a binary: `launch.executablePath` / `launch.channel` in the plugin config.
## Tools
The default `toolPrefix` is `browser_`. Every action returns a fresh snapshot, so refs always come f
rom the latest result. The registered set is capability-gated: `browser_evaluate`, `browser_cdp` and
`browser_extract` appear only when their capability is switched on (their schemas are resident in t
he system prompt on every turn, so a tool that could only answer "disabled" would be pure prompt cos
t). Count the live surface with `npm run cost` — the shipped `cordis.patch.yml` keeps **both power g
ates off** (since 0.4.7), so a profile mounting this bundle sees **16 tools**; 17 or 18 once your de
ployment opts into `evaluate` / `cdp`, 19 with `diagnostics: true`, 21 once `extract` is configured.
How to opt in: paste the snippet under Known Limitations below, or use the built-in Settings card.
| Tool | Purpose |

| `browser_navigate` | Open a URL (http/https only) and return the snapshot |

evidence.fact: README说明 agent 可在可见浏览器中使用已登录账号，处理页面和表单，遇到登录、挑战或弹窗时交给用户。
evidence.quote: DSH 的浏览器：登录一次，它就用你的账号替你办事（查后台/填表/抓列表/多标签）；要登录、验证码、弹框会停下来等你，绝不替你点「确定」；你最小化它就不吵你，AI 在哪动手你随时看得见
